name: ctx
description: Persistent context for AI coding assistants

interface.longDescription: ctx keeps decisions, learnings, tasks, and conventions in a .context/ directory that travels with the repo. This plugin wires ctx into Codex: the context packet is injected at session start, lifecycle hooks nudge persistence and gate risky commands, the ctx MCP server exposes status/search/tasks, and the ctx-* skills (remember, wrap-up, commit, ...) are available as $ctx-<name>.
defaultPrompt: Do you remember what we were working on?
Let's wrap up: persist what we learned
What should we work on next?
